title: How a Man of God Keeps Reading Scripture When He Feels Nothing
caption:
A man of God opens the Bible even when he feels nothing.

Feeling was never the requirement. Obedience that shows up on the dry days is where a man gets built.

Shrink it to one page. Read it out loud. Ask one plain question. Then tell God the truth: this feels empty. Psalm 13 starts with "How long, O Lord?" and the man who wrote it kept coming back.

What is one page you can read tomorrow morning before your phone?

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
